content.short: Nilos is a B2B cross-border payments platform with multi-currency and stablecoin accounts across 120+ countries.
content.description: Nilos is a business payments platform that helps companies collect, convert and pay out money across emerging and global markets through a single API. It offers multi-currency accounts for collections, global payments over local rails, foreign exchange, and stablecoin accounts, so businesses can move money between fiat and stablecoins such as USDC and USDT. Regulated in France, the Netherlands and Canada and reaching more than 120 countries, Nilos serves import-export merchants, global corporates managing subsidiary transfers, and fintechs and neobanks that want to add multi-currency and stablecoin payments. It handles treasury and reconciliation so finance teams can manage crypto and fiat flows in one place.
content.meta: Nilos offers B2B multi-currency and stablecoin cross-border payments and treasury. Discover Nilos and other Neobanks on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
